S3-12.title: A/P Summary: each export states the as-of date and the filters
S3-12.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, location A and your other location.
  • Make sure vendor A and vendor B each have bills at location A that were 31 to 60 and more than 90 days past due on Oct 15, 2026.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Summary (Reports, then "A/P Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with the as-of date set to 10/15/2026 and only location A ticked in the Location filter (the Location column is hidden).
S3-12.custom_steps:
1. In the Past due filter, tick "91+ days", then "31-60 days".
  2. In the Vendor filter, tick vendor B, then vendor A.
  3. Choose "Download (PDF)" from the ⋯ menu.
  4. Open the PDF and read the lines under its title.
  5. Choose "Download (CSV)" from the ⋯ menu.
  6. Open the CSV and read the lines at the top.
S3-12.custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Both ranges are ticked.

Step 2:

  • Both vendors are ticked.
  • The chip reads "Vendor: 2 vendors".

Step 3:

  • The PDF downloads.

Step 4:

  • The lines read "As of Oct 15, 2026", then "Locations: " and location A's name, then "Past due: 31-60 days, 91+ days" (menu order, not the order ticked), then "Vendors: " and vendor B, vendor A (the order ticked).
  • The PDF has no Location column.

Step 5:

  • The CSV downloads.

Step 6:

  • The CSV starts with four rows of one line each, in this order: "As of: Oct 15, 2026", then "Locations: " and location A's name, then "Past due: 31-60 days, 91+ days", then "Vendors: " and vendor B, vendor A.
  • The column heading row follows directly.
  • There is no Location column.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 11 (5 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 10 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV), story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location), story SV-11536 (Story 6, Location column)
